name: TypeaheadOption
description:
One row of a typeahead. A press does not take focus from the text, and the highlight
follows pointer movement, not hover, so a list scrolling under a still pointer leaves it
where the keyboard put it.
signature: ({ listId, index, active, selected, onPick, onActive, describedBy, className, children }: TypeaheadOptionProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: active
props.description: Whether this is the highlighted row.

props.name: className
props.description: Row classes. Default: the shared menu row.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: The id of the text describing the row.

props.name: listId
props.description: The listbox id. Rows are `${listId}-${index}`, which `aria-activedescendant` names.

props.name: onActive
props.description: Called with the row's index as the pointer moves over it.

props.name: onPick
props.description: Called on a click, Enter or Space.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the row is selected. Default: while it is highlighted. Pass a value when the list marks picks.
